verdict.rationale: The API reference claims programmatic access to "all aspects of the Braintrust platform": projects, experiments, datasets, logging, prompts, tools and scorers. The `bt` CLI, MCP server and multi-language SDKs extend this to log querying, evals, Topics configuration and function management. The parity claim rests on vendor docs alone, and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found at the standard probed paths, which weakens discoverability for AI-native use. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation of full UI/API parity, explicit API coverage of UI-centric features (playgrounds, annotation interfaces, dashboards, Patterns), and a discoverable OpenAPI spec.
